bugs_found: compound_interest accepts negative principal while loan_payment rejects it, enabling inconsistent invalid financial states
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), so fractional inputs change meaning without validation
transfer mutates account_from before account_to; if account_to.balance addition fails or has side effects, funds are debited without crediting
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal/finite, allowing type errors or NaN/Infinity behavior instead of controlled rejection
apply_fee preserves non-string non-Decimal amount types; float amount causes Decimal*float TypeError and bypasses precision policy
apply_fee can return negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, with no validation that fee <= amount
fx_convert does not validate rate is positive and finite, so zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates can produce invalid conversions silently
all functions lack explicit finite-number validation, so NaN/Infinity inputs can raise inconsistent Decimal exceptions or propagate invalid monetary values
